blurb: Guests rent powerboats, waverunners, paddle boards, and kayaks for watersports and tours on Lake Tahoe. Boats include wakesurf boards, wakeboards, waterskis, tubes, instruction, and life jackets. Captains licensed by the US Coast Guard and expert wakesports instructors are available.

Lake Blvd., Carnelian Bay, CA 96140
